title: PopescuDelocalizeJacobianLocalization
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, N,c,t natural numbers with c ≤ N, f_j ∈ R[x₁,...,x_N] for j < c, s₀,...,s_t ∈ R, and h ∈ R[x₁,...,x_N]. Let Δ = det(∂f_j/∂x_i) for the first c variables [def-weil-pbc-polynomial-partial-derivative]. Assume s₀-hΔ ∈ (f). In the polynomial ring P = R[x₀,x₁,...,x_N,w] [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], insert f by x_i ↦ x_i, and form D=P/(f). Let a be the class of x₀ w ∏_{j=0}^t s_j. Then the localization D[1/a] [def-weil-ring-localization-away] is standard smooth over R [def-weil-pbc-standard-smooth-algebra], using its composite R-algebra structure. Empty determinants equal 1.

theorem popescu_auxiliary_isStandardSmooth
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (N c t : ℕ) (hc : c ≤ N)
    (f : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin N) R)
    (s : Fin (t + 1) → R) (h : MvPolynomial (Fin N) R)
    (hs : C (s 0) - h * Matrix.det
      (fun i j : Fin c => pderiv (Fin.castLE hc i) (f j)) ∈
        Ideal.span (Set.range f)) :
    Algebra.IsStandardSmooth R (Localization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk
      (Ideal.span (Set.range (fun j : Fin c =>
        rename (fun i : Fin N => i.castSucc.succ) (f j))))
      (X (0 : Fin (N + 2)) * X (Fin.last (N + 1)) * C (∏ j : Fin (t + 1), s j))))
